findings.description: The change introduces ~15 major new components not required by the user intent: ContextSwitcher (3 profile contexts), FloatingKeyboardOverlay (new keyboard implementation, 534 lines), VoiceBridgeServer (loopback HTTP server, 214 lines), VoiceManager (TTS, 117 lines), DriftCalibrator (analog stick drift, 77 lines), DebugOverlay (88 lines), LegendOverlay (137 lines), PinStore (49 lines), GroqKeyStore (30 lines), ConsentManager (26 lines), PttController (71 lines), plus extensive ProfileManager/ControllerProfile/TextStyles/InputMapper rewrites. The user intent explicitly describes only THREE text-editing gaps (caret-aware mutations, D-pad/HAT caret movement, backspace hold) plus a ProfileSerializer REV bump. Per simplification rules, each unrequired component should be evaluated for removal unless the change's own stated purpose requires them.

REV=4 migration (line 70-78) discards ALL user-customized button mappings from any profile with rev < 4, keeping only tuning values (sensitivity/deadzone/cursorEnabled/invertScroll). This is a breaking data-loss change for existing users. The user intent acknowledges this as a 'safety net for the RS/Enter bug' but it must be explicitly documented in release notes so users know their custom mappings will be reset.

The change introduces significant new pure/testable logic without corresponding tests: caretIndex() (line 879), moveCaret() (line 1005), deleteToLineStart() (line 1043), DriftCalibrator (new file), ContextSwitcher (new file), FloatingKeyboardOverlay (new file), InputMapper hysteresis (InputMapper.kt:69), PttController (new file). AGENTS.md explicitly recommends adding JUnit tests for non-trivial logic in these pieces. No test suite exists in this port yet.

moveCaret() calls focused.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SET_SELECTION, args) but ignores the Boolean return value. If the accessibility node doesn't support ACTION_SET_SELECTION (e.g., non-editable fields, some custom views, API level limitations), the caret movement fails silently without any indication to the user or logging. The user intent requires reliable caret movement for text editing; silent failure could leave the user confused why D-pad left/right 'doesn't work' in certain fields.

testing_summary: No tests were run during this review phase per pipeline rules. The change introduces significant new logic (caretIndex, moveCaret, deleteToLineStart, DriftCalibrator, ContextSwitcher, FloatingKeyboardOverlay, PttController, VoiceBridgeServer) without a test suite. Live validation on device was acknowledged as unavailable in this sandboxed environment.
risk_rationale: The change is a massive scope expansion (37 files, 4346 insertions) far beyond the user intent's three specific text-editing fixes + REV bump. While the core required functionality appears correctly implemented, the introduction of ~15 unrequested major components (ContextSwitcher, FloatingKeyboardOverlay, VoiceBridgeServer, VoiceManager, DriftCalibrator, DebugOverlay, LegendOverlay, PinStore, GroqKeyStore, ConsentManager, PttController, etc.) constitutes a fundamental deviation from stated requirements that needs explicit human approval before merge.
